e2a_selection_rule: maximum development Top-1; ties use config order

contract.accumulator: INT32 with absolute-prefix proof; INT64 software storage
contract.requant: RNE(acc*N/2^shift) once, then ReLU if required, then saturation
contract.residual: requantized Conv2 code and skip code; common denominator, sum then ONE RNE; ReLU+clip
contract.gap: INT64 sum of 64 codes; rescale including /64; ONE RNE; clip
contract.fc: INT32 common output code, scale=2^-16, no ReLU; argmax first index on ties
